newsitem.title: USA: Task force to advise Reno on special counsel.
newsitem.headline: Task force to advise Reno on special counsel.

text.p: Attorney General Janet Reno said Thursday the Justice Department task force investigating Democratic fund-raising practices has orders to let her know if it uncovers evidence warranting an independent counsel.

"I have advised the task force that is pursuing this investigation that if at any time any evidence is developed that triggers the appointment of an independent counsel, we will do so based on the evidence and the law," Reno said.

She said at her weekly news briefing that the task force has been investigating allegations of illegal campaign fund raising in the 1996 presidential campaign and would "pursue every lead as thoroughly and vigorously as possible."
Reno has steadfastly refused to seek an independent counsel, saying the law's threshold -- specific, credible evidence that a covered person has committed a crime -- has not yet been met.
"I have to comply with that statute," she said.
Reno's comments came a day after the Senate voted along party lines in urging her to seek an independent counsel to take over the investigation from the Justice Department.

By a 55-45 vote the Senate approved a non-binding resolution saying there had been "specific, credible information" of possible criminal violations by the Democratic National Commmitee and President Clinton's campaign.
Reno has until mid-April to respond to last week's request from Republicans on the Senate and House judiciary committees asking her to begin the procedures leading to an independent counsel.
